status: First working water authoring/rendering implementation. Photorealistic production quality and 1080p/30 FPS in the dense tropical scene remain unfinished.
implemented: Explicit undoable conversion from the legacy plane, independent sea level and ocean visibility.
Camera-following ocean; up to 16 independently elevated ellipse, polygon or connected-basin water bodies.
Clear tropical, lake, pond, muddy and open-ocean presets; editable visibility, color, roughness, waves, ripples and terrain foam.
Shared HDR color/depth capture, approximate refraction and absorption, dielectric sky/screen-space reflections, basic underwater attenuation.
Native persistence, undo/redo, staged resource preparation and selection preservation on failed duplicate followed by retry.
Submerged runtime boundary walls close open heightfield edges; no added collision geometry.
Fix development startup by fetching the default-foliage public catalog as data, with failed/cancelled preparation retry.

validation.visual: Inspected final browser coastline fixture: ocean, submerged terrain, bank walls and contact foam render. The finite authored seabed edge remains visible underwater; off-map seabed is unknown. Final dense coastline inspection was blocked by unexpected integrated-adapter selection.

performanceMethod.command: npm run dev -- --port 5190 --strictPort; node scripts/benchmark-water.mjs <external scene.terrain> .qa/water-performance.json [dev URL] [coast|canopy]
performanceMethod.source: External Tropical Grove — banana trail, 88 m terrain, 7,323 foliage instances. Source content project unchanged; water added only in benchmark memory.
performanceMethod.device: Confirmed NVIDIA RTX 5060 Laptop GPU, Chrome 155, Windows ANGLE D3D11, 1920 x 1080 for the two preliminary reports below.
performanceMethod.sampling: Fixed fullscreen first-person camera, 2.5-second warmup and 180 rendered frames per mode. GPU timer covers environment rendering. CPU numbers are JavaScript submission duration. FPS is wall-time render cadence, not display scanout.
performanceMethod.qualification: These two runs precede the final submerged boundary-wall and single-pass correction. Treat their timings as preliminary scene-cost observations, not final water overhead. No precise causal speed comparison can be drawn from small differences amid local background variability.
performanceMethod.finalAttempt: A repeat after the corrections selected AMD Radeon 860M despite Chrome's --force-high-performance-gpu flag. The benchmark rejected the adapter before timing. No integrated-GPU results are accepted and no Windows graphics settings were changed.
performanceMethod.limits: Short fixed views, development server, uncontrolled background activity/thermal state, no physical input-to-display measurement. The canopy view has little visible water. Other scenes/devices and longer sessions remain unmeasured.

pending: Final dedicated-GPU measurement and continued dense-scene optimization toward 30 FPS.
Planar/off-screen reflections, spectral ocean waves and breaking surf/crest whitecaps.
Caustics, wet-bank shading, water-specific temporal history and motion handling.
Worker-based basin preparation, richer outline handles, swimming and buoyancy.
Static GLB water is approximate and bounded; runtime boundary walls are not included in its presentation geometry.
